final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS order_channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_recordvault_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderbase), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(distinct_recordvault_count) AS total_distinct_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.order_channel, step1.avg_filled_quantity, step1.distinct_recordvault_count, 1.0 * step1.distinct_recordvault_count / step2.total_distinct_count FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2
